$comment: Per-project dependency graph. nodes=modules, edges=[cause,effect] (cause is imported-by effect). Seeded by hand at G2 (19 Oct 2026) from the architecture chosen in G0.5 (approach A, with C as rung 1); no code exists yet. Regenerate the skeleton with tools/graphizer.mjs once src/ has modules; KEEP the invariants, they are hand-written.
$edge_note: contracts (Finding, Review, Job) and config are the centre: they import nothing from the project. Adapters (llm_client, embedder, github_client, store) sit behind interfaces so a paid tier can replace a free one by config (kickoff Q1). trace is cross-cutting: everything may import it, it imports only contracts.

invariants.every_posted_finding_is_grounded: A finding reaches GitHub or the approval queue only if its file_path and line range exist in the PR head AND were in the context the specialist actually received. Otherwise it is dropped and the drop is traced. VERIFIER TEST: feed a specialist a stubbed LLM response citing a file/line that was never retrieved; the review must contain zero findings for it and the trace must show one 'finding.dropped{reason=ungrounded}'. (Guards kickoff Q11: the confident, wrong finding.)
invariants.one_live_job_per_work_key: For one (repo, pr_number, head_sha) there is at most one live review job, under concurrency. VERIFIER TEST: ingress matrix T8, the same delivery fired 50x concurrently, gives exactly 1 job; T7, opened + ready_for_review on the same SHA, gives 1 job.
invariants.bot_never_approves_or_merges: No code path calls a GitHub API that approves a PR, requests changes as a blocking review, or merges. Reviews are posted as COMMENT only. Until a confidence threshold calibrated on the golden set is recorded in config, nothing auto-posts: every review goes to the approval queue. VERIFIER TEST: grep the github_client for approve/merge endpoints (must be absent); with no threshold configured, run a review end-to-end and assert zero direct posts and one approval-queue entry.
invariants.every_outbound_call_is_bounded: Every call to an LLM, the embedder, GitHub or the store has an explicit timeout and a defined failure path (retry budget, then dead-letter or degrade). VERIFIER TEST: inject a hanging stub for each adapter; the job must finish (failed or degraded) within its timeout and never hang.
invariants.dependencies_point_inward: contracts and config import nothing from the project; adapters never import orchestrator/specialists/hitl; no cycles. VERIFIER TEST: run graphizer and check every edge against this file's edge list.
